question: Does Quave ONE offer a separate Hobby-account record with its own published compute allowance, and what are the Connect tier-by-tier monthly license amounts that the pricing-details page says live in the Adhesion Agreement?
why: The Hobby account is unbilled and needs no card but is evaluation-only in US-1 Hobby, and the Connect tiers are published only as capacity bands from $399/month; neither has a published per-resource rate to price a separate record.
